description: This file is a Java class implementation for a service that manages 'CodeValue' entities, including creating, updating, and deleting code values within a domain model. It uses Spring annotations for transaction management and caching, and interacts with repositories and domain objects to perform data operations. It also contains error handling for data integrity issues and exceptions.

classes.name: CodeValueWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of service for managing CodeValue entities, providing create, update, and delete operations with proper exception handling, security context, and cache management.

methods.name: createCodeValue
methods.description: Creates a new CodeValue entity based on the provided JSON command, performs validation, and handles data integrity issues.

methods.name: updateCodeValue
methods.description: Updates an existing CodeValue entity identified by its ID with data from JSON command, with validation and integrity checks.

methods.name: deleteCodeValue
methods.description: Deletes a CodeValue entity linked to a Code, with data integrity exception handling to prevent deletion if in use.
